question: Explain how a transistor can be used as a switch in digital circuits. Relate its ON and OFF states with logic levels.

options.A:
OFF state
With negligible base current, the transistor is in cut-off; collector current is nearly zero and it behaves as an open switch, representing logic $0$.
ON state
With sufficient base current, it reaches saturation; a large collector current flows and it behaves as a closed switch, representing logic $1$.
options.B:
OFF state
Cut-off has maximum collector current and represents logic $1$.
ON state
Saturation has zero current and represents logic $0$.
options.C:
OFF state
The transistor is always saturated regardless of base current.
ON state
It cannot be associated with logic levels.
options.D:
OFF state
Both cut-off and saturation have identical collector current.
ON state
Digital circuits require more than two states.
